page.overview:
Who is Dick?

Dick is a man that wears a yellow scarf that extends behind his head, black goggles and a blue hat, he also wears matching blue pants and shirt for his uniform. Dick also has yellow gloves and boots, and carries a gun as his primary weapon. He has a brown bag that has a strap that wraps around his shoulder, and has a tube that connects to the back of his head.
